Everything you need

A whole cash counter in one app

From the first sale to the monthly report, Cash Memer handles it — no printer, no paperwork, no fuss.

Beautiful cash memos

Build professional receipts with items, quantities, discounts and tax — and watch them render live as you type. Add your logo and digital signature for a branded touch.

AI Receipt Scanner

Snap a photo or pick from your gallery — Gemini-powered OCR reads the items and totals for you in seconds.

Barcode, NFC & scanners

Ring up products fast with the built-in barcode scanner, NFC tags, or an external hardware scanner — and write product IDs onto blank NFC tags for physical labeling.

Live currency rates

Real-time exchange rates for 150+ currencies via ExchangeRate-API. Set custom currencies and convert on the fly.

Sales dashboard

See today's sales, revenue, total products and scans at a glance — plus a built-in weather widget for your store.

Cloud sync & backup

Sign in with Google to sync receipts across every device. Export, back up and restore your data anytime.

Locked down tight

Protect the app with Face ID, Touch ID or a custom passcode. Your books stay yours.

No ads, ever

Your counter is a workspace, not a billboard. Cash Memer is completely ad-free — nothing between you and the sale.

Regularly updated

Frequent free updates bring new features, currencies and refinements to every platform.

Bilingual & themeable

Switch instantly between English and Urdu — اردو — with full right-to-left support, and choose a Light, Dark or System theme. The whole app adapts to feel right at home.

Customer directory

Save every customer's name, phone, email and address once, then attach them to a memo in a single tap.

Built-in product catalog

Keep a searchable catalog with barcode, SKU, category, stock and pricing — or use the quick price list for on-the-fly items.

Weekly AI insights

A plain-language weekly summary from Gemini, plus the numbers that matter — top item, best customer, total spend.

Annotate & search every memo

Every receipt opens as a zoomable PDF you can search, mark up with notes and checkmarks, and share in a tap.

Smart & connected

Woven right into your device

Cash Memer doesn't just sit on your home screen — it plugs straight into the system you already use every day.

Built in

Just say the word

Cash Memer is wired deep into App Intents, so its actions belong to the whole system. Ask Siri to "start a new cash memo," surface today's rates straight from Spotlight, or drop any action into a Shortcut or your Home Screen. The app comes to you — no tapping, no digging through menus.

Available now

Powered by Apple Intelligence

Cash Memer taps straight into Apple Intelligence to work smarter for you. Summarise a day's takings, polish receipt notes with Writing Tools and get context-aware suggestions — all handled privately, right on your device. Your books, only sharper.

Available now

Speaks your customer's language

Fully localised — set your device to any language and Cash Memer follows. Buttons, receipts, number formats and even right-to-left layout all adapt properly, never machine-translated. English and اردو ship today, with more on the way. Pick a language, and it just works.

The output

One tap. A memo worth keeping.

This is a real cash memo made in Cash Memer — nothing mocked up. The maths is done, the place is stamped, and every copy carries a scannable QR record. Tap it to take a closer look.

  • Change, done for you

    Enter the cash given and the change is worked out instantly — $500 in, $296 back.

  • Tax & totals that add up

    Subtotal, a tax rate you set, and a grand total — recalculated on every edit.

  • Per-item pricing

    Quantity times unit price on every line — 12 eggs at $16.67 each.

  • Stamped with a place

    Each memo saves the address and exact GPS where the sale happened.

  • Scannable QR record

    A QR code on every receipt links to the full digital details.

  • Your shop, your details

    Store name, customer, category and payment method — all on the memo.
